hfa_test.points_used: HFA constant 2.5 remains a model choice (flag F02): the home/road split proves a home edge exists but does not measure its size in points.

independence.note: Lag-1 correlation of a player's own PTS across consecutive games. Small |r| supports treating legs from different games as approximately independent; it cannot prove independence.

luck.breakeven_formula: 110 / (110 + 100) for a -110 price (arithmetic, not an NBA statistic)

power_vs_breakeven.note: beyond the 25,000-bet cap: a 53% true edge is not certifiable in any realistic window; approximation only

illustrations.scenario: Break-even bettor (p = break-even) goes 55-45 over 100 bets
illustrations.reading: Not evidence of skill at alpha=0.05.

illustrations.scenario: Break-even bettor reaches at least 55% over 200 bets
illustrations.reading: Runs this hot purely by chance a large fraction of the time.
Power is far below 80% — 200 bets cannot certify a 55% edge.

deflation_rule.formula: (wins + K*p0) / (n + K) with K = 25, p0 = break-even rate
deflation_rule.note: Shrinks a short hot streak toward break-even before it can enter the leaderboard.

gates.name: Provenance
gates.rule: Every value has an official nba.com URL and a snapshot date; no value is inferred.

gates.name: As-of integrity
gates.rule: Snapshot taken before tip-off of the listed games; no post-game information in features.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Strategy rules frozen before any price is observed; the rule text is published verbatim.
gates.status: PASS (rules frozen in strategies.csv before any pricing)

gates.name: Sample adequacy
gates.rule: n must exceed the exact-binomial requirement for the claimed edge at alpha=0.05 / power 0.80.

gates.name: Out-of-sample
gates.rule: Second, non-overlapping evaluation window after the rule is frozen.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: Held-out Brier score must beat the no-vig market baseline; reliability inspected.

gates.name: Market price
gates.rule: A timestamped, de-viggable price from a named book is required for any edge, CLV or ROI.

gates.name: Joint pricing
gates.rule: Combo legs priced from empirical joint outcomes, not the product of marginals.

gates.name: Multiple testing
gates.rule: Holm/Bonferroni-adjusted alpha across every candidate tried.

gates.name: Luck deflation
gates.rule: Deflated (shrunken) rate and deflated Sharpe framework applied before ranking.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.rule: Sensitivity across model parameters (K, HFA) published for every line.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.rule: Frozen paper-trading window with a pre-committed stopping rule.

strategies.name: Own-line spread disagreement
strategies.rule: Bet the side where |own spread - market spread| >= 2.0 points, only if the market is at least 30 minutes old and the price is at -110 or better.

strategies.name: Own-line total disagreement
strategies.rule: Bet over/under where |own total - market total| >= 3.0 points, price at -110 or better.
strategies.corr: spread x total within a game is not modelled

strategies.name: Moneyline value
strategies.rule: Bet the moneyline side whose de-vigged market probability is below the model probability by >= 3 percentage points.
strategies.inputs: moneyline model (BLOCKED: margin SD constant unverified)

strategies.name: Two cross-game spread singles
strategies.rule: Combine two S01 qualifiers from different games; only if the offered parlay price beats the independence price by >= 3%.
strategies.corr: cross-game independence assumed, tested only weakly (lag-1 table)

strategies.name: Three cross-game singles
strategies.rule: As S04 with three legs; independence price = product of leg probabilities.

strategies.name: PTS + 3PM, Edwards
strategies.rule: Same-game combo PTS >= L and 3PM >= K for Anthony Edwards; price from the empirical joint rate (PC1), never from the product of marginals.

strategies.name: PTS + AST, Doncic
strategies.rule: Same-game combo PTS >= L and AST >= K for Luka Doncic; price from the empirical joint rate (PC3).

strategies.name: Edwards PTS + Doncic PTS
strategies.rule: Two-leg cross-game prop parlay; independence allowed only while the lag-1 table shows |r| < 0.10 for both players.

leaderboard.unit: audit unit (1 unit = 1 flat stake at the observed price)
leaderboard.scoring: score = deflated_rate * sqrt(n) * mean_de_vigged_CLV_sign, with deflated_rate = (wins + 25*p0)/(n + 25)
leaderboard.entries_note: No entry is graded: no strategy has a settled bet (G04/G07 fail closed).
anti_gaming: Only pre-registered rules may be scored; a rule changed mid-window restarts its sample at zero.
Legs must be priced from the same snapshot; any leg without a verified price voids the entry.

flags.title: No verified market odds
flags.detail: No timestamped price from a named sportsbook was obtained in this session (sandbox outbound access is limited to GitHub hosts; nba.com is reachable only through the page fetcher, which does not serve book prices). Every edge, CLV, ROI and reward cell is therefore blank.

flags.title: Home-court advantage is a constant
flags.detail: HFA = 2.5 points is a model choice. The official home/road splits show a home edge exists (see HFA test) but do not measure its size in points.

flags.title: Small samples
flags.detail: 2026-27 teams have played 6-9 games; prop logs contain 4 (Edwards) and 8 (Doncic) 2026-27 games. Shrinkage is applied and flagged.

flags.title: Edwards participation
flags.detail: Anthony Edwards appears in 4 of Minnesota's 9 games on the official box-score page; the reason is not on the page and no official injury report was accessed. Availability is unverified.

flags.title: Games page static render is empty
flags.detail: https://www.nba.com/games?date=2026-11-05 renders 'No Games Scheduled' while the official month calendar on the same page shows 2 games for 2026-11-05. The slate was transcribed from /schedule instead; the discrepancy is recorded, not resolved.

flags.title: NBA Cup treatment unverified
flags.detail: Nine of the eleven slate games are Emirates NBA Cup group-play games listed on the regular-season schedule. Whether/how they count toward the standings is NOT verified in this session.

flags.title: 2025-26 prior table is secondhand
flags.detail: The prior-season team table was transcribed by session 6d508fee and reused here. Internal consistency was re-checked (X08); the underlying page was not re-fetched in this session.

flags.title: Moneyline model blocked
flags.detail: A win-probability model needs a margin standard deviation and a calibration constant; neither is verified from an official source, so moneyline probabilities are left blank.

flags.title: Prize pool unfunded
flags.detail: Reward tiers are proposals. No sponsor, budget or payout mechanism exists; amounts stay blank.

flags.title: Prop settlement rules unverified
flags.detail: Void, DNP, stat-correction and overtime/OT-inclusive scoring rules for player props were not verified against any operator's published rules.

flags.title: No injury/availability feed
flags.detail: No official NBA injury report or official availability feed was accessed; all prop lines are unconditional on participation.

flags.title: Prior table net does not sum to zero
flags.detail: Sum of (net points/game x GP) in the reused 2025-26 table is -16.4 over 2,460 team-games; consistent with 1-decimal rounding per row but recorded as an irregularity.

flags.title: Cyrillic character in an inherited CSV header
flags.detail: nba-signal-lab/data/teams_2025_26.csv and teams_2026_27.csv name a column 'blkа_pg' with U+0430 CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER A instead of ASCII 'a'. This session's copy normalises the key; the source files are owned by another session and were not edited.

flags.title: Standings GB column is win%-based
flags.detail: Conference leaders show GB '--' even when their records differ in games played (POR 6-1 above LAL/HOU 7-2 in the West). GB is computed against win% rank, not games behind; read it with care.
